title: An asymptotic bootstrap method and its applications to Hermitian matrix models
summary: We propose an asymptotic bootstrap method to evaluate moment integrals that arise in problems related to hermitian matrix models. These are normalized integrals of the form $a_n=\int^{\infty}_{-\infty} x^n \exp(-V(x)) dx$ where $V(x)$ is a polynomial of $x$. The method is applicable even when the coupling constants in $V(x)= x^{2\ell}/(2\ell) + g_{2\ell-2} x^{2\ell-2}/(2\ell-2) + \dots$ are complex.
